notes: Applicant from Morocco with a Moroccan Baccalauréat: this is a BUT (Bachelor Universitaire de Technologie) at I.U.T. de Valenciennes, and the programme page is an official Parcoursup form. The Campus France Morocco page « Candidature en 1ère année BUT à l'université (IUT) » gives a deadline of 1 October 2026 to 15 November 2026 for the Études en France/ADIUT Maroc procedure, but the fact schema only provides intakes and applicationChannel; applicationChannel is deliberately omitted per the task, and the deadline is left in this note rather than encoded, because it is the Campus France/ADIUT Maroc national procedure for first-year BUT, not the programme's own Parcoursup page dates. The fee of EUR 2 902 per year comes from the national Campus France Morocco page and applie to extra-communautaire (Moroccan) students in their first Licence year, unless the establishment exempts them; the page does not confirm whether this exemption applies to this programme, so the amount should be verified with the establishment. The page does not state an application opening date, a programme duration in ECTS or semesters, or a document list for this programme.
